title: 3-SPEED AUTO TRANS.-TRIM PLATE & SEALS
summary: Automatic transmission (M40) shifter area on the floor tunnel: the console shift trim plate (shifter bezel), shift knob with push button and spring, the shift lever and bracket assembly, and the tunnel shifter opening seal stack (plate, seal, retainer). The plate is riveted to the tunnel (production rivets), the seal sits on it and the retainer and lever bracket are screwed down through the stack with screw assemblies; View A gives the tunnel hole pattern to drill.

parts.name: PLATE ASM.-TRIM
parts.name_expanded: Plate assembly - console shift trim plate (shifter bezel/indicator plate)

parts.name: RETAINER
parts.name_expanded: Retainer - shifter opening seal, on tunnel

parts.name: SEAL
parts.name_expanded: Seal - shifter opening in floor tunnel (shifter boot)

parts.name: LEVER & BRKT ASM
parts.name_expanded: Lever and bracket assembly - automatic shift lever

fastening.note: Plate [8] is fastened to the tunnel with production rivets (PROD. RIVET, no callout).

Retainer [6] clamps seal [7] over plate [8]; screw assemblies [5] go down through retainer and seal into the tunnel holes (View A: eleven 1/4 dia holes, drilled using the countersunk hole as locator and retainer [6] as template).

Lever and bracket assembly [9] screwed down with screw assemblies [5]; one more corner uses a production screw (PROD SCREW SEE UPC 7). A production clip on the bracket (see UPC 12) is shown at the RH screw.
Knob [3] goes on the top of the lever with spring [2] and button [1] in its top; retention method not shown.
Trim plate [4] sits in the console (CONSOLE ASM. SEE U.P.C. 1); attachment not shown.
